note: Excel number formats: code, stored value, date system, expected text. Expectations are typed by hand from Excel's documented display behaviour and the build's rules (a full date is MM/DD/YYYY; a malformed code or an unshowable value is General). type n = a numeric cell's stored <v> text, s = a text cell, d = an ISO date cell (t="d").
